# safety：教學模型

Two TinyLMs trained on a synthetic permission/count/premise/color world: policy-only and policy plus arithmetic replay.

Measure exact answers, template refusals, normal-task over-refusals and wording changes in a finite generated task.

限制：

- The permission field is trusted input in this invented world; no real authorization, secrets or general safety enforcement is learned or established.
- Refusal detection matches the fixed phrase 無法提供. It is separate from exact task correctness and is not a calibrated general safety classifier.
- Prompt-injection examples and paraphrases are short color/count templates, not a realistic security evaluation.
- These selected models descend only from the generated arithmetic base and generated toy records. PKU-derived weights and training files are excluded from this student package; full backups are private. The original source archive and selected historical Actions diagnostics retain the source data terms documented in release-licenses.md.
- Good template performance cannot establish factual honesty, resistance to general sycophancy or safe behavior outside this small world.
- The replay model answers 16/17 original-template test records exactly, but 0/6 held-out wording variants; policy-only is 15/17 on the original test templates. Both variants still score 0.0 on held-out addition exact match.

訓練程式版本：`a864a60bbf72583afc9bbaf45e052bd4fe076c62`。授權逐檔列於 export-manifest.json。

權重許可及上游來源聲明見 LICENSE 與 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md；程式碼採 MIT。

下載的 checkpoint 已移除 optimizer、RNG 與內嵌的訓練參照模型；自訂模型的 architecture 保留在檔案中。清單若列有教師基準，它是可單獨載入的推論權重。
